archetypes.rationale: Golden fixtures must match live legacy scan_file identities and rendered lines exactly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the three JSON fixtures and the adapter message mappings in test_lint_engine_equivalence.py. Confirm each fixture rule id matches the detector SUPPRESSION constant, repository-relative python/ paths, line numbers tied to embedded sources, and that markdown/unreachable messages retain pattern_name or normalized_condition plus occurrence while self-disarmable reuses the legacy message.
